name: Gill Design, Inc.
old_description: A proven leader in the PCB industry, Gill Design, Inc. is dedicated to providing the highest-quality pcb, cable, and wire products with advanced technology, competitive pricing, and unmatched service.
about:
Gill Design, Inc. is a small, women-owned company founded in 1990 and based in Windham, New Hampshire. The firm began by providing electro-mechanical printed circuit board design, fabrication, and assembly services to the electronics industry.

Today the company offers a full suite of PCB services including design, fabrication, and assembly for single-sided through complex multi-layer boards, using Orcad schematic net lists to produce complete Gerber packages with DXF files. Its capabilities extend to jacketed and coaxial cables, custom test fixtures, box builds, chassis assembly, and wire harnesses for aircraft, automobiles, and spacecraft. Electrical and mechanical engineering support is also available to verify design integrity.

Gill Design serves clients in naval and defense, medical, aerospace, communications, and energy sectors, as well as automotive and space applications through its wire harness products.

The company emphasizes environmentally friendly production, stating it uses no toxic substances in any process, and maintains ITAR compliance for defense-related work. Its New Hampshire location also provides tax-free purchasing for customers.
